# SBFB / nexus-grid

> Decentralized P2P compute network for apps. No central server, no admin, just
> protocol. Anyone publishes a web app from verifiable source; the network
> distributes it; clients render it in a sandboxed iframe via the Rust blob-serve
> daemon. AGPL-3.0.
>
> **Scope of this index — the sharding, factory and workflow subsystems.** This
> `llms.txt` indexes the subsystems that have a dedicated agent-consumable docs
> layer: **distributed-inference (sharding)**, **app-authoring (factory)** and
> **workflow agents (runtime)** — the latter seeded S83 and still under
> construction. A whole-repo agent index is **deferred** (its own future
> phase/sprint). For everything else, read `CLAUDE.md` (project overview) and
> `docs/claude/README.md` (workflow).

## Sharding (distributed LLM inference)

- [Sharding agent index](docs/sharding/llms.txt): the entry point — Truth Stack, PROVISIONAL status, links to the wiring spec, wire primitives, runnable examples, and human docs.
- [Wiring spec for agents](docs/sharding/WIRING_SPEC.md): contract-dense, source-anchored — read before wiring or reviewing the pipeline.
- [Wire spec](docs/protocol/SHARD_PROTOCOL_SPEC.md): machine wire spec — domain tags, generated JSON Schemas, types, caps.

## Factory (app-authoring)

- [Factory agent index](docs/factory/llms.txt): the entry point — Truth Stack, PROVISIONAL status, links to the wiring spec, gate primitives, runnable example, and human docs.
- [Wiring spec for agents](docs/factory/WIRING_SPEC.md): contract-dense, source-anchored — the sealed-iframe CSP contract, the non-delegable gate, the prompt-kind, INVIOLABLE invariants.
- [Factory gates](docs/factory/FACTORY_GATES.md): the 11 publish gates; FG-CSP-authoring (static scan) + its runtime net (self-check viewer).

## Workflow agents (host runtime, under construction S83)

- [Workflow agent index](docs/workflow/llms.txt): the entry point — Truth Stack, delivered-so-far map (pack format, compiler, durable run store, run store loopback read surface), rank-1 sources.
- [Workflow reference](docs/workflow/REFERENCE.md): the run store loopback API family — envelopes, D7 tiers, deferred mutating family.
- [Chantier GUIDE](docs/factory/WORKFLOW_AGENTS_OVERVIEW.md): the 4 authority layers + phase map; grows each phase, finalized at the S83 wrap-up.

*The indexed subsystems have their own agent docs layer; everything else is
intentionally not agent-indexed yet (whole-repo index deferred). For project
orientation read the human files named in the scope banner above (`CLAUDE.md`,
`docs/claude/README.md`).*
